zones.name: Loch Modan
zones.summary: Dwarf and Gnome second zone: Thelsamar hub, the Loch shore and Stonewrought Dam, Algaz, Farstrider Lodge, Ironband’s Excavation, and the Mo’grosh stronghold. Leads on to the Wetlands.

zones.name: Teldrassil
zones.summary: Night Elf starting zone: Shadowglen, Dolanaar hub, Starbreeze Village, Lake Al’Ameth, the Oracle Glade, Gnarlpine Hold, and the Rut’theran crossing to Darkshore.

zones.name: Darkshore
zones.summary: Night Elf second zone: Auberdine hub, the northern coast and Twilight Vale, the Ruins of Mathystra, Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran, the Tower of Althalaxx, the long southern coast to the Master's Glaive, and the beached-creature series. Leads on to Ashenvale in the south.

quests.name: The Family and the Fishing Pole
It's All Fun and Games Until...

zones.name: Stormwind City
zones.summary: The first city guide: the Alliance capital as a repeat-visit hub — districts, class and profession lines, the Defias and Diplomat chains, the Stockade, the Onyxia and epic-mount endgames, and accept-based expeditions to 20+ zones.

quests.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

zones.name: Ironforge
zones.summary: The second city guide: the dwarven capital as a repeat-visit hub — districts, class and profession lines, the Uldaman and Gnomeregan chains, the Magni endgame and dungeon-tier set, and accept-based expeditions to 20+ zones.

zones.name: Darnassus
zones.summary: The third city guide: the night elf capital as a repeat-visit hub — the Temple of the Moon, the Cenarion Enclave and the trades terraces, the druid class chain flagged for the future Set 4 druid guide, the Moonglade link, and accept-based expeditions to 15+ zones.

zones.name: Redridge Mountains
zones.summary: Set 2 opener: Lakeshire hub, the gnoll and orc lines, the Rethban and Alther’s Mill chains, the messenger exits to Stormwind, Westfall and Duskwood, and the western oddities. Leads on to Duskwood and the Burning Steppes.

zones.name: Ashenvale
zones.summary: Set 2 second zone (Alliance): Astranaar hub, the Tower of Althalaxx chain, Raene’s Cleansing, the Foulweald and Xavian lines, the Stonetalon exits, and the western oddities. Leads on to Stonetalon and the Barrens.

zones.name: Stonetalon Mountains
zones.summary: Set 2 third zone (Alliance): Stonetalon Peak hub, the Gaxim/Kaela and Gerenzo chains, Windshear Covert Ops, the Charred Vale, the south-camp Desolace-border finales, and the custom object chain. Leads on to Desolace and the Barrens.

zones.name: Duskwood
zones.summary: Set 2 finale (Alliance): Darkshire hub with Night Watch, Stalvan, Sven, Abercrombie, Viktori and Carevin chains, Raven Hill, the custom Nightmare mission board, writs and twins. Leads on to Stranglethorn and Redridge.

Duskwood Mission XI: Cold Iron Ore
Duskwood Mission XVI: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade
Duskwood Mission XVII: Rescue Alara Grovemender
Duskwood Mission XVIII: Rescue Elenora Marshwalker

zones.name: Wetlands
zones.summary: Set 3 opener (Alliance): Menethil Harbor hub with the Halloran, Boran barrel, Third Fleet, Lightforge, Dragonmaw and Diplomat chains, the digsite and Dun Modr south, Rethiel east, the Shaman water chain, Villard far south and Kixxle writs. Leads on to Arathi, Dustwallow and the city expedition legs.

quests.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
In Search of The Excavation Team
Craftsman's Writ: Draught of Water Breathing

zones.name: Stranglethorn Vale
zones.summary: Set 3 (Alliance): two-pass route - northern jungle (Nesingwary camp, Rebel Camp, Kurzen compound, east jungle) then Booty Bay and the cape; expedition legs to Badlands, Swamp of Sorrows, Arathi, Tanaris, Hillsbrad, Duskwood, Dustwallow, Alterac, Thousand Needles, Hinterlands and Riverglades. Leads on to the next Set 3 zone.

quests.name: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

zones.name: Riverglades
zones.summary: Set 3 (Alliance route in a shared Forever-original zone): Farholde command, the western Twilight front, the central farms, Powderfuse Port and the northern ogres; expedition legs to Stormwind, Tanaris and Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: If a Tree Falls, and No One Hears...

zones.name: Thousand Needles
zones.summary: Set 3 (Alliance-accessible route in a contested zone): Whitereach, the Mirage Raceway chains, the Shimmering Flats pilots, the mage line and the Geomancy scroll; expedition legs to Ratchet, Booty Bay, Badlands, Dustwallow, Gadgetzan, Undercity and STV Hemet.

zones.name: Desolace
zones.summary: Set 3 closer (Alliance route in a contested zone): Nijel's Point, the Magram and Gelkis clan chains, the kodo country, the coast and the mage line; expedition legs to Maraudon, the Swamp of Sorrows, Booty Bay and Stormwind.

quests.name: A New Need for Shadow Protection

zones.name: Hillsbrad Foothills
zones.summary: Set 4 opener (Alliance route in a contested zone): Southshore hub, the Syndicate north, the murloc coast, the Dibbs scholar chain and the seasonal pair; expedition legs to Ironforge, Stormwind, the Wetlands, Arathi, Silverpine, Alterac and Booty Bay.

zones.name: Arathi Highlands
zones.summary: Set 4 second zone (Alliance route in a contested zone): Refuge Pointe hub, Stromgarde streets, the Myzrael binding stones, the Faldir's Cove seafarer chain, the Shaman and Mage class lines; expedition legs to the Wetlands, Hillsbrad, Ironforge, Stormwind, Stranglethorn, Desolace, Razorfen Kraul and Ravenholdt.

zones.name: Alterac Mountains
zones.summary: Set 4 second zone (Alliance route in a contested zone): the mountain crossing between Hillsbrad and the Plaguelands, the Syndicate documents that clear the Hillsbrad 512/514 debt, the Ansirem and Modera chains, the warrior Cyclonian line, rogue Ravenholdt follow-ups, high finales to 46, and optional writ turn-ins.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength

zones.name: Moonglade (Druid)
zones.summary: Set 4 druid class guide (Alliance route): the bear, aquatic, cure and cat chains in level order plus the level-50 Torwa chain; expedition legs to Stormwind, Darnassus, Darkshore, Alterac and Un’Goro.

quests.name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit

zones.name: Dustwallow Marsh
zones.summary: Set 4 contested-zone Alliance route: the Theramore chains, the Jarl and Tabetha lines, Nat Pagle and town content, the writs and the goblin trio; expedition legs to Astranaar, Uldaman and Stormwind.

quests.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
Elrick, Paladin of the Silver Hand

zones.name: Feralas
zones.summary: Set 4 contested-zone Alliance route: the Feathermoon Hatecrest and courier chains, the Kindal and Troyas lines, the Wild Leather profession chain, the OOX and Zorbin neutral chains, the druid quest, the WANTED poster, the below-band stragglers and the level-60 writs; expedition legs to Darnassus, Booty Bay, Thousand Needles, Tanaris and Stormwind.

quests.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home

zones.name: Tanaris
zones.summary: Set 4 contested-zone Alliance route: the Gadgetzan water/silithid chains, the Trenton mithril trio, Stoley and Tranarek lines, the Yehkinya Sunken Temple chain, the Noggenfogger and Torwa UnGoro lines, the Marvon circle and Linken chains, the OOX rescue, the Tazzik Steamwheedle chain, the writ and armorsmith profession lines, and the below-band on-ramps; expedition legs to Darnassus, Booty Bay, Thousand Needles, Ironforge, Teldrassil, UnGoro and zone 2548.

quests.name: A Good Head On Your Shoulders

zones.name: Badlands
zones.summary: Set 5 contested-zone Alliance route: the Theldurin/Myzrael and Lost Fragments chains, the Rigglefuzz gadgetzan outpost lines, the Lotwil/Lucien elemental chains with the Hard triple finale, the Tremors of the Earth chain, the Ryedol/Hammertoe survey chain, the Martek on-ramp, the Yagyin Ironforge delivery, the Murdaloc object-start, the four Craftsman writs, and the Dorgaron Safety Checks; expedition turn-ins to Arathi, Ironforge and Loch Modan.

zones.name: Blasted Lands
zones.summary: Set 5 contested-zone Alliance route: the Kum'isha draenethyst chain (2521/3501/93685), the Drazial/Lynnore beast-reagent chain, the Grimshade medallion chain with Hinterlands finale, the Ardalan/Ragnar delivery finales, the Lynnore Forever pair, the Nethergarde orphan chain with Alterac finale, the Bernie basilisk-scale quest, and the Grand Alliance Hyjal breadcrumb.

zones.name: Searing Gorge
zones.summary: Set 5 contested-zone Alliance route: the Suntara escort, the Prayer to Elune twilight cultists, the Tailoring Undermarket, the Kalaran Windblade weapon chain with tower finale, the Dying Archaeologist finale duo, the Onyxia-note delivery, the Outhouse/Caught chain with Tanaris finale, the Thorium Point hub with bounty board, the Burning Beast etching with Blasted Lands finale, the Lunar elder, and the five Craftsman writs.

zones.name: Felwood
zones.summary: Set 5 contested-zone Alliance route: the Emerald Sanctuary Eridan chains (Jadefire, Felbound, Aquementas with Tanaris/UnGoro legs), the Timbermaw/Winterfall split with Winterspring expedition farms, the Warlock Niby/Impsy chains (Azshara + Dark Portal expeditions), the Greta Shadow Hold chain with Barrens/Hyjal ends, the Arko/Trey rescue, the Gorn peace chain via Winterspring to Ironforge, the Meilosh turn-ins, the Paladin custom quest, the Stag Bauble, the Lunar elder, and the six Craftsman writs.

zones.name: Azshara
zones.summary: Set 5 contested-zone Alliance route: the Loramus/Arkkoroc Name of the Beast chain with the Felwood and Stranglethorn ends, the Truesong/Saria/Berdun hub chains (Spitelash, tablets, Mosshoof, honey, fishery, Blackmaw), Kimjael equipment and Lohuatu ghost/satyr pairs, the Ogtinc/Xylem Hunter/Rogue/Mage/Priest class chains with Ravenholdt and Felwood ends, the Hydraxis EPL/Feralas expeditions, the Tymor Ironforge return, the Lunar elder and the Demonslaying writ.

quests.name: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore

zones.name: Un'Goro Crater
zones.summary: Set 5 contested-zone Alliance route: the Krakle springs with Winterspring ends, the Layo southwind pair and Umber Moonglade link, the Linken raft-to-Winterspring chain, the Marshal expedition trio plus journal, the Muigin bloodpetal chain with Feralas ends, the A-Me escort chain, the Collie crystal pylons, the Ringo escort, the Pterrordax boards, the Hermit Twilight Silithus block, the Lunar elder, Torwa Uncanny pair, the Hyjal book pointer, and four Craftsman writs.

quests.name: A Little Help From My Friends
Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards
Craftsman's Writ: Thick Leather Ammo Pouch

zones.name: Silverpine Forest
zones.summary: Set 6 Horde route: the Sepulcher hub chains (Dalar, Quinn/Yorick, Rot Hide ferry, apothecary, shadow priests, Beren, Arugal, Hillsbrad breadcrumb), the Fenris Isle legs, the Shaman Call of Water, the Rogue Horn of Xelthos, the Undead Paladin Earthen Ring line, the Offering Stone, Tabitha, the Undead-only hub quests, the Dalaran object-starts and the Undercity ends, plus soft-pre minis for the Tirisfal/Hillsbrad/Barrens pres.

zones.name: Silverpine Forest (Alliance)
zones.summary: Alliance addendum: the Alliance-only Silverpine accepts the Horde census set aside - the Modera trio (92457/92458/92459, pre 92432 Hillsbrad, kills and Celindra turn-in in Alterac), Kwee seasonal 8993, and the Dwarf/Gnome Shaman link 94505 (pre 94503 Westfall, ends Norric Loch Modan). 94501 excluded: accepts in Wetlands, already Wetlands-contracted.

zones.name: The Barrens
zones.summary: Set 6 Horde route: the Crossroads hub chains (Sergra, Thorn Hill, Grol'dom, Regthar, Wenikee, Jorn, Devrak, Darsok, Varoot, Rahauro, Grunt Logmar, Thork, Apothecary Jorell, Melor), the Wailing Caverns druid line, the Hunter beasts and Rogue Shaw chain, the Camp Taurajo and Sun Rock Retreat legs, the Ratchet goblins, the Samophlange and Blueleaf quests, the Ashenvale/Durotan/Mulgore/Stonetalon/Dustwallow/Thousand Needles border chains, the Shaman Call of Water finales, Tear of the Moons, and the Freewind/Thunder Bluff exits, plus soft-pre minis for the Mulgore/Moonglade/Durotar pres.

quests.name: Trial at the Field of Giants
Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm
Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards

zones.name: Swamp of Sorrows
zones.summary: Set 6 Alliance route: the Nethergarde caravan chain (Biggs), the Harborage draenethyst line (Magtoor), Galen, the Fallow Sanctuary legs, Cortello's Riddle, the entomology specimens, four Craftsman's Writs, and the Blasted Lands / Riverglades / Desolace / Dustwallow expedition turn-ins.

zones.name: The Hinterlands
zones.summary: Alliance route: Aerie Peak hub (Fraggar, Tove Redstone, Farseer Maret), Rhapsody chain with Kalimdor expedition ingredients, OOX-09/HL rescue with Booty Bay turn-in, Jammal'an finale, Skulk Rock cleanup, troll necklace twins, gryphon-egg rescue, and three sourceless Craftsman's Writs.

zones.name: Western Plaguelands
zones.summary: Alliance route: Darrowshire chain out of Pamela/Carlin, Light’s Hope Argent hub with Stratholme/Scholomance dungeon legs, Aurora Skycaller chain with Azshara/Feralas/Darnassus expedition legs, Menethil chain exiting to Andorhal, Anthion tier-0.5 chain with Ironforge turn-ins, armor-scrap heads, world-drop Front letters, and the northwest roaming quests.

quests.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent

zones.name: Eastern Plaguelands
zones.summary: Alliance route: Chillwind cauldron chain with tower legs, Tirion Fordring redemption chain, Chromie Andorhal chain feeding WPL, Scholomance key/fragment chain with Tanaris turn-in, Ras Frostwhisper chain feeding WPL Leonid, Argent commission, paladin line, plague-upon-thee below-band chain

zones.name: Burning Steppes
zones.summary: Alliance route: Morgan/Maxwell hub chains with Blackrock interior legs, warlock Dreadsteed chain, Bodley endgame chain (lowest-ID path), deferred Badlands/Searing Gorge above-band pickups, Maxwell-to-Stormwind and Leonid finales
